# Yahoo Sports

> > Comprehensive sports coverage featuring live scores, team news, game highlights, and streaming guides across NBA, WWE, MLB, and more.

Yahoo Sports provides real-time sports news, team pages with rosters and statistics, game recaps with box scores, and streaming guides for major sporting events. Coverage spans professional leagues including NBA (Boston Celtics, Portland Trail Blazers), WWE wrestling events (Elimination Chamber, WrestleMania), World Baseball Classic, and compelling human interest stories from the world of sports.
